WITH first_ver AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id FROM (
    SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) rn FROM dim_member) WHERE rn=1),
cur AS (SELECT member_id, home_store_id cur_home FROM dim_member WHERE is_current)
SELECT f.home_store_id, count(*) n_first, sum(CASE WHEN c.cur_home=f.home_store_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_as_cur
FROM first_ver f JOIN cur c USING(member_id)
WHERE f.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH signup_version AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id
  FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS rn FROM dim_member)
  WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, count(*) AS new_members
FROM signup_version v
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = v.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE v.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY s.store_id
